text:
noah: Quick heads up: planning an integrator onboarding pilot next month. Need to finalize curriculum, trainer kit logistics, certification rubric, and marketplace bundle. Meeting 11am PT tomorrow to triage. Who's in?

tara: I'll join. We need a modular curriculum: core deploy, observability, and one custom integration lab (e.g., CRM connector).

ben: For trainers, propose 6 seats (3 lead trainers + 3 shadow trainers). Shadow trainers should be actual SI engineers where possible.

emily: Ops note: shipping kits to EMEA/NA only. Cost estimates: $1.3k per kit including preloaded images and test harness. Need PO by next Wed.

noah: Certification: prefer a two-tier approach (Certified Integrator, Certified Integrator - Advanced). Basic = deploy + smoke tests; Advanced = customization + runbook + SLA demo.

renee: Legal wants exact marketplace copy for SLA and data processing. Keep privacy-safe wording for demo datasets.

tara: Curriculum outlines: Day 0 pre-read (infra, tokens, security), Day 1 deploy + smoke, Day 2 observability + rollback, Day 3 integration lab + certification run.

ben: Add a short automated checklist trainers run after each lab: curl to sandbox generate, nvidia-smi check, and log export. I'll sketch script.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Ticket INFRA-1032 created for trainer VPN + scoped KMS keys (expires in 12 days).

emily: For air-gapped installs, we must provide a signed tarball and pinned image SHAs; add this as optional appendix.

noah: Marketplace artifact: single listing with optional add-ons: trainer kit, on-prem license, and installation support. Need Terraform and Helm quickstart templates.

tara: I'll draft the Helm chart example. Keep quantized model image as optional artifact to keep bundle small.

ben: For validation, do we accept video demos? Some integrators can't grant live access.

emily: We can accept recorded demos for deployment flow, but telemetry and rollback must be reproducible in our sandbox or via log exports. Document in FAQ.

noah: Timeline: curriculum draft by Tue EOD (tara), trainer scripts + smoke tests by Wed (ben), infra tickets filed (emily), marketplace quickstarts by Thu (noah/tara). Pilot cohort in ~3 weeks.

renee: Partnerships will prepare a private beta announcement for selected SIs after we confirm pilot capacity. Recommend limit to 4 partners initially.

tara: Also add a trainer feedback form to collect pass rates and common blockers. Might help tweak labs before broader rollout.

ben: Sample smoke test snippet for playbook appendix:

ben: ```bash
# simple smoke test
curl -s -X POST https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","input":"Ping"}' | jq .
ssh kit 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv'
# retrieve latest logs
scp trainer@kit:/var/log/redwood/* ./logs/
```

emily: I'll attach cost request PARTN-511 to track kit approvals.

noah: Good. Can someone volunteer to create the partner signup form and intake questionnaire? Need to capture infra constraints, preferred lab dates, and NDAs.

tara: I'll do the form. Will post link in pre-read doc.

ben: One more ask: add a short troubleshooting playbook for common failures (image mismatch, token errors, GPU driver mismatches). I'll draft common errors and suggested fixes.

noah: Great. I'll send calendar invite and a pre-read with links to current playbook & checklist. Drop any links here and I'll include them. :thumbsup:
